name: hcportal_getKennelProducts
description: One kennel's product catalogue for the portal Products view (run packages, memberships, haberdashery, away weekends). Includes items taken off sale unless @activeOnly = 1, and unlike the app's rowset returns SourceJson (supplier detail), which is deliberately kept off hashers' phones. Pricing lives in one PricingJson field (fixed, member/non-member, choice, per size, deposit + balance); the client derives margin. Order of checks: @publicKennelId NULL (before auth), HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (@publicKennelId as context), kennel exists, then HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageProducts' (GM, VGM, Hash Cash, Haberdasher or the ManageHashCash flag). Read-only. HC.Product has no file in db/schema/tables; column types are from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_create_Product.sql and 2026-09-13_product_json_rework.sql.

parameters.name: activeOnly
parameters.description: 0 (default) returns everything the kennel has listed and not removed, 1 only what is on sale. NULL behaves as 1 (`@activeOnly = 0` is unknown, so only IsActive = 1 rows pass).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on 'Null or invalid publicKennelId', auth failure, 'Kennel not found', a manageProducts denial ('You are not authorised to manage this kennel''s products.', not logged), or from the CATCH (ERROR_MESSAGE(), logged to HC.ErrorLog).

rowsets.name: Products
rowsets.description: On success: the kennel's live (Removed = 0) products, ORDER BY IsActive DESC, SortOrder, Name. May be empty.

columns.name: productType
columns.description: Product.ProductType: 2 membership, 3 haberdashery, 4 run package, 5 away weekend

columns.name: productDetailsJson
columns.description: Product.ProductDetailsJson — per-type detail, photos (PhotoUrls moved here)

columns.name: isActive
columns.description: Product.IsActive — on sale; not the same as Removed

columns.name: unitsSold
columns.description: COUNT of HC.Payment rows with this ProductId and removed = 0; drives the take-off-sale-instead-of-delete warning

codeSmells.detail: Lines 89-93: a manageProducts refusal returns the envelope with no HC.ErrorLog row, so repeated refusals are invisible.
Line 122: `@activeOnly = 0 OR p.IsActive = 1` with NULL drops inactive rows; the documented default is 0 (everything).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
sourceJson must never be added to an app-facing rowset
